def anonymous_target.{u_1} : {I :
    Type u_1} →
  [inst : Fintype I] →
    (NNReal → ↑(Metric.sphere 0 1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ I) → (NNReal → ℝ) → I → NNReal → ↑(Metric.sphere 0 1) → ℝ :=
fun {I} [Fintype I] u temperature i t w => (-u t w - (temperature t * ↑(Fintype.card I - 1)) • ↑w).ofLp i
approved_definition_context: The unit-sphere subtype in this statement is the sphere of radius 1 centered at zero in EuclideanSpace ℝ I, with its induced topology and Borel measurable structure. Coercion from the subtype means inclusion into that Euclidean space.
